#### Study summary card (agent-filled from the original paper)

**Breast cancer** -- Kumar et al. 2023, *Nature* 620(7972):181-191, PMID 37380767. Spatially resolved single-cell genomic atlas of the adult human breast: 714,331 cells from 126 donors (86 normal breast, 40 cancerous), 10 cell types. Note: no cancer cells per se (contralateral unaffected breast samples were taken; 'Cancer' = donors with cancer). Source: Zenodo 14615923 (`BreastCncr_processed.h5ad`, md5 `8b28a349c2c3638ddbfb3946a32d12ba`). Batch-candidate variables: 10x v2 vs v3 chemistry, sample prep.

> **To fill after the first successful load:** download date + md5 from
> `download_log.md`, and the confirmed `sample` / biological-label / batch /
> cell-type columns (section 3 prints the actual obs columns + candidate
> detection below).

```{python}
# Resolve effective columns: prefer the confirmed/best-guess names, fall back
# to the first detected candidate.
def pick(guess, candidates):
    if guess is not None and guess in adata.obs.columns:
        return guess
    return candidates[0] if candidates else None

cand = ou.candidate_col_detection(adata.obs)
SAMPLE_COL = SAMPLE_COL or pick("Sample", cand["sample"])
BIO_COL = BIO_COL or pick(None, cand["label"])
CT_COL = CT_COL or pick(None, cand["cell_type"])
if not BATCH_COLS:
    BATCH_COLS = cand["batch"][:4]
print("effective SAMPLE_COL:", SAMPLE_COL)
print("effective BIO_COL:", BIO_COL)
print("effective BATCH_COLS:", BATCH_COLS)
print("effective CT_COL:", CT_COL)
```

```{python}
cps = ou.cells_per_sample_stats(adata.obs, SAMPLE_COL) if SAMPLE_COL else {}
{k: v for k, v in cps.items() if k != "cells_per_sample"}
```

```{python}
if SAMPLE_COL:
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"sample": list(cps["cells_per_sample"].keys()),

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
```

```{python}
# n unique cell types per candidate CT/annotation column
ct_cands = [c for c in adata.obs.columns if c in cand["cell_type"]]
pd.DataFrame({
    "column": [c for c in ct_cands],
    "n_unique": [int(adata.obs[c].nunique(dropna=True)) for c in ct_cands],
    "na_count": [int(adata.obs[c].isna().sum()) for c in ct_cands],
})
```

```{python}
# NaN check in CT columns (Lee/Zhang HiTME NaN precedent): a NaN-heavy CT
# column breaks downstream PILOT-style methods unless guarded.
ct_na = pd.DataFrame({
    "column": [c for c in ct_cands],
    "na_count": [int(adata.obs[c].isna().sum()) for c in ct_cands],
    "pct_na": [float(100 * adata.obs[c].isna().mean()) for c in ct_cands],
}).sort_values("pct_na", ascending=False)
print(ct_na.to_string(index=False))
bad = ct_na[ct_na["pct_na"] > 5]
if len(bad):
    print("WARNING: CT columns with >5% NaN:", bad["column"].tolist())
```

```{python}
# Gene-symbol sanity: mouse vs human (Diabetes is mouse!)
h = adata.var_names.astype(str)
mouse_frac = float(h.str.startswith(("Mgi", "Gm", "Rpl", "Rps")).mean()) if len(h) else 0.0
um = h.str.upper()
mt_frac = float(um.str.startswith("MT-").mean())
mito_frac = float(um.str.startswith(("MT-", "Mt-")).mean())
print(f"n genes: {len(h)}")
print(f"mouse-style prefixes (Gm/Rpl/Rps/Mgi...): {mouse_frac:.3f}")
print(f"MT- (human) fraction: {mt_frac:.3f}; mt-/MT- (case-insensitive) fraction: {mito_frac:.3f}")
print("first 20 genes:", h[:20].tolist())
```

```{python}
pixi = shutil.which("pixi") or f"{Path.home()}/.pixi/bin/pixi"
rscript = [
    pixi, "run", "-e", "default", "Rscript", "--vanilla",
    str(HERE / "onboarding_metrics.R"),
    "--input", str(OUT / "metrics_input.feather"),
    "--ct-col", str(CT_COL), "--bio-col", str(BIO_COL),
    "--batch-cols", ",".join(BATCH_COLS),
    "--out-csv", str(OUT / "metrics_separation.csv"),
    "--out-json", str(OUT / "metrics_separation.json"),
]
print("running:", " ".join(rscript))
res = subprocess.run(rscript, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
print(res.stdout[-2500:])
```

```{python}
sep = pd.read_csv(OUT / "metrics_separation.csv")
sep
```

```{python}
# Heatmap: cell-type x label separation (1 = perfect separation)
import re
mat = sep.set_index("cell_type")
score_cols = [c for c in mat.columns if c.endswith("_separation")]
status_cols = [c for c in mat.columns if c.endswith("_status")]
lab = {c: re.sub("_separation$", "", c) for c in score_cols}
hm = mat[score_cols].rename(columns=lab)
status_tab = mat[status_cols].copy()
status_tab.columns = [re.sub("_status$", "", c) for c in status_cols]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(4, 1.1 * len(score_cols)), max(4, 0.42 * len(hm))))
sns.heatmap(
    hm.astype(float), annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap="RdYlGn", vmin=0, vmax=1,
    mask=hm.isna(), linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={"label": "LISI separation"}, ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title(f"{NAME}: per-cell-type LISI separation (unintegrated PCA)")
fig.tight_layout()
ou.save_png(fig, OUT / f"{NAME}_metrics_separation_heatmap.png")
print("status table:")
print(status_tab.to_string())
```

#### Summary + recommendation

Feasibility table: batch-effect (10x v2/v3 + sample prep). No cancer cells per se (contralateral unaffected donors).
